crossRefs.note: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you.…
For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says Yahweh.
That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month…
Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river…
Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Because you have said, “Yahweh has raised us up prophets in Babylon;”
translations.bsb: Because you may say, “The LORD has raised up for us prophets in Babylon,”
translations.kjv: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
translations.asv: Because ye have said, Jehovah hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
